page.overview:
What is Anhur?

General of the Gods Supreme Marshall of All Armies Champion of Physical Prowess The Falcon of War God of War, Thunder, Rain, and Storms

Anhur (}}), also known as Ramathant in Thay and Ramman, Rumathep or Ramatep in Unther, was a wise and peace-loving deity. His role was protecting Mulhorand from evil, a task for which he remained ever-vigilant while still finding the time to appreciate those he defended.

Anhur typically appeared as a Mulan human with four arms, red skin, and dark eyes. His hair appeared dark, and he usually had a short beard that was often braided.

Anhur's will was often made known through the actions of animals, such as lions, falcons, and trained war beasts or guard animals, as well as the uncontrolled actions of war chariots.
